selection_policy: Superseded Calcify throughput harnesses and research spikes: the generic full-path smoke (wrong ingress profile for 10k), the October 2 joined-capacity driver and its accounting helper, the October 1 resolver proof runners, and 12 Kotlin research spikes that are not run by CI. Exact tracked bytes at master; no ignored files, no live state, no evidence directories.
